cards.text: Zechariah the prophet is having a night of visions, with an angel there to talk him through them, and he just saw a gold lampstand. Now he looks up again and sees a scroll. FLYING. Friend, the only paper I ever saw fly was a takeout menu when somebody slammed the junk drawer.

cards.question: The angel asks Zechariah what he sees, and he describes the flying scroll. The scroll is small enough to hold in one hand.

cards.text: Twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide. That's about thirty feet by fifteen, which means this isn't a scroll, friend, it's a BILLBOARD with a pilot's license.

cards.question: The angel tells Zechariah what the flying scroll is. What does he call it?

answers.text: The curse going out over all the land
The law going out to every nation
The record of everyone sent back home

cards.text: One side of the scroll says every thief will be removed, and the other side says every perjurer will be removed. Front AND back, friend, this scroll does NOT waste paper.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts says He will send the curse out, and it will enter the house of the thief. Whose house will it also enter?

answers.text: The one who swears falsely by His name
The one who bows down to carved idols
The one who works on the Sabbath day

cards.question: Once the curse enters the thief’s house, it only stops by for a moment and then moves on.
The curse moves into the house and stays. What does it do to that house?

answers.text: Destroys it down to its timbers and stones
Marks its door so everyone will know
Empties it of everything inside of value

cards.text: Then the angel tells Zechariah to look up and see what's approaching, and Zechariah asks what it is. After a flying billboard, I bet he's not ruling ANYTHING out.

cards.question: The angel tells Zechariah what’s going forth. What is it?
The angel says the measuring basket stands for something: “This is their ___ in all the land.”

cards.text: And behold, the lead cover is raised, and there's a woman sitting inside the basket. Friend, I spent YEARS in the dark of a junk drawer, and nobody EVER put a lead lid on me.

cards.question: The angel tells Zechariah who the woman in the basket is: “This is ___,” he said.
Then the angel ___ the woman down into the basket and pushes the ___ cover back over its opening.

cards.text: Then Zechariah looks up again and sees two women approaching, with the wind in their wings, wings like a stork's. Meanwhile I get around by hopping, and this gold base comes with me EVERY single time.

cards.question: The two winged women come to the basket with Wickedness inside. What do they do with it?

answers.text: Lift it up between heaven and earth
Drop it down into the deep sea
Set it down by the temple gate

cards.text: Now the basket's up in the air, and Zechariah asks the angel where they're taking it. Friend, that is the EXACT question I asked every time somebody opened that drawer.

cards.question: Where does the angel say the two women are taking the basket?
The angel says the basket will be thrown away once it gets to Shinar.

cards.text: A house gets built for the basket in Shinar, and when it's ready, the basket is set there on its pedestal. Zechariah's night of visions isn't over yet, friend, so keep that oven warm.

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 11 quotes "This is their ___ in all the land.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The opening card has 4 sentences: 'Zechariah the prophet is having...', 'Now he looks up again...', 'FLYING.' and 'Friend, the only paper...'. The limit is 3.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on. If the passage starts in the middle of a thought, it gives the context.

findings.problem: The card states facts from outside the passage: Zechariah is a prophet, an angel talks with him, and he just saw a gold lampstand (Zechariah 4:2). It gives no reference for them and cites only Zechariah 5:1.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: Card 5, a story card, already says the other side of the scroll removes every perjurer. That gives away card 6's answer, the one who swears falsely by His name. Nothing has been answered that this could build on.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. Once a choice has been answered, the cards after it can build on that answer.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'Empties it of everything inside of value' is close to the right answer. A house destroyed down to its timbers and stones (Zechariah 5:4) loses everything inside, so a baker could argue this answer is right.

rule.text: A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.

findings.problem: Card 12 says 'the lead cover is raised' and 'a lead lid', which gives away the second blank (lead) on card 14.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
